subject: Dedicated capacity evaluation — concurrency & latency constraints

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@splitter.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity evaluation

Hi Markus,

I filled out the demo form this morning — thanks for the quick turnaround. We're Splitter Inc, building a realtime routing layer for conversational agents. A few high-level constraints so the call is productive:

- Expected steady-state: ~4–6M tokens/day; peak bursts up to ~250 qps sustained for 30–45s.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 150ms for short prompts (~32 tokens).
- We need a Dedicated deployment (data isolation + predictable throughput).
- Compliance: SOC2 is a must; we can share a questionnaire in advance.

Attaching a short summary of our traffic profile (splitter_query_summary.pdf). Would prefer an initial 45-minute slot with a solutions engineer + an AE to go over architecture/constraints.

We're on PST (San Francisco). My availability this week: Tue 10–12, Wed 14–17, Thu 9–11 (all PST).

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah

Thanks for the traffic summary — that burst profile is helpful. Quick notes so we can scope:
- Dedicated is the right starting point; we may recommend an autoscale buffer for burst windows.
- For latency SLOs we'll want to see sample prompt lengths and a representative workload (we can run a short local profile).

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 10:30–11:15
- Wed 15:00–15:45
- Thu 09:30–10:15

If none of those work, tell us your best two times and we'll try to accommodate. Also, would you be able to share a couple of example requests and an internal contact for SRE/infra? That helps our solutions engineer prep.

Best,

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood supports prefix/KV caching at the Dedicated level? We rely heavily on KV reuse.
2) If we surface our SOC2 questionnaire now, can someone on your security team confirm whether any answers are conditional on deployment mode (hosted vs. dedicated)?

I'll upload a small CSV of representative requests to the shared drive once we confirm the time.

Quick answers:
- KV/prefix caching: yes, our Dedicated runtime includes KV cache controls; Kimberly (SE) will cover caching strategy and how it impacts cost and p95.
- SOC2: some evidence items are the same across modes (e.g., incident response), others (e.g., data residency controls) differ slightly with private/on-prem options.
